result.reason: The operative language includes the required performance standard, 90-day Site conformance warranty, remedies, legal compliance, and malicious-code protection, while preserving the existing provisions. However, it provides no express 90-day preferred or 30-day fallback warranty period for Services; the margin comment offering that fallback does not cure the omission. It also limits the conformance warranty to the “Site,” rather than clearly covering all deliverables/software. The uncapped Services warranty therefore does not precisely implement the playbook duration and changes more than necessary.
